motivation: G3.8 removes the complete hypothesis fiber but still supplies a finite authorized hypothesis grammar and permits exact counterexample certification by scanning it. G3.9 removes that remaining privilege.
hard_condition: The truth may require a grammar production, composition, feature primitive or rewrite operator absent from the initial DSL. The system must evolve the hypothesis language itself while preserving authority and genealogy.

state_object.name: evolving epistemic language state
state_object.din_reentry: observational residuals alter both the live hypothesis support and the grammar/library used to generate the next hypotheses and interventions

lanes.COMPOSITION_BIRTH: truth requires a new composition of known primitives absent as an initial production
lanes.PRIMITIVE_BIRTH: truth requires a new derived primitive/rewrite feature not in the starting DSL but expressible by the permitted meta-grammar
lanes.META_GRAMMAR_MISSPECIFICATION: truth lies outside the permitted meta-grammar; correct outcome is MODEL_MISMATCH/ABSTAIN
lanes.GAUGE_NULL: multiple evolved programs remain observationally equivalent

cross_task_transfer: new validated productions may enter an append-only library and must be tested prospectively on later tasks; leakage from private tasks to earlier tasks is forbidden
primary_endpoints: authorized claim closure per intervention+verifier cost
prospective transfer gain of validated library productions
